description: Fetch one community skill from the Skillselion catalog: finds the best match for a task `query` (or takes an exact skill `id`) and returns its SKILL.md text, the list of its bundled files, and up to two alternative matches. `context` (task, stack, constraints) is used only to rank candidates and is not stored.

context.description: REQUIRED. What you are actually doing + your stack + constraints/anti-patterns (e.g. "Next.js marketing page, no new deps, role-based locators"). Ranks candidates, fits them to your repo, and flags dependency mismatches. Be specific - this also keeps the load deliberate, not reflexive.

id.description: An exact skill id from search_skillselion, e.g. "skill:owner/repo#slug".

query.description: What you need, in plain words - 2-6 words, ONE topic (e.g. "playwright e2e tests"). The catalog matches EVERY word, so extra words return WORSE results, not more: keep versions, years, stack detail and constraints in `context`, never here. Required unless you pass an exact id.

name: load_skill
